Dear Mr. Reiss:
This project agreement (the "Project Agreement"), is entered into by and between
Burson-Marsteller ("Burson") and Philip Morris Incorporated ("Philip Morris") pursuant to
the agreement, dated as of January 1, 1993 (the "Agreement"), by and between Burson and
Philip Morris Management Corp. It sets forth the terms and conditions under which Burson
has performed and will continue to perform services beginning as of January 1, 1997, and
continuing through the later of the completion of the services to the reasonable satisfaction of
Philip Morris or March 31, 1998.
Burson will provide general public relations advice to Philip Morris and third
parties designated by Philip Morris regarding communications and media training for event
marketing spokespersons if, as and when requested or approved in advance by Philip Morris.
In full and complete consideration of the services rendered throughout the term
of the Project Agreement, Philip Morris will pay Burson monthly fees, in accordance with
the then current rate schedule attached to the Agreement as Exhibit B, for each hour actually
spent by Burson personnel in performing services pursuant to the Project Agreement.
Invoices for services will be itemized and will be based on the specified staff hourly rates
supported by position and name of staff member, date work performed, hours of work and
specific project worked on. Total fee payments to Burson for services throughout the term
